card.name: Section names in bracketed cross-references
card.fires_on: The first piece of a section title inside a bracketed cross-reference such as "[see Dosage and Administration (2.4)]", e.g. "Dos", "Sup"/"plied", "Ind". Also fires on the bracket or the start of an instruction just before it.

modes.label: Section title start after see
modes.description: The opening piece of a section name like Dosage or Indications right after "[see".
modes.example: discontinue LUNSUMIO based on severity [see<< Dos>>age and Administration (2.4)

modes.label: How Supplied reference
modes.description: The end of "Supplied" in a "How Supplied/Storage and Handling" cross-reference.
modes.example: administered as soon as possible [see How Sup<<plied>>/Storage and Handling (16)

modes.label: Capitalized warning or bracket
modes.description: An all-caps instruction word or opening bracket near the end of a label statement.
modes.example: For oral inhalation only.<< DO>> NOT swallow tiotropium bromide

card.writes: It seems to push toward completing section-title wording inside cross-references, though the promoted tokens look mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the section name in a "[see Dosage and Administration]" style pointer in a drug label.
